title: Posterior Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.13994v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Flow matching learns how to transport noise toward data, but its mean prediction does not directly report the endpoint uncertainty remaining at an intermediate state. This paper introduces Posterior Flow Matching (PFM), a general generative modeling framework that learns conditional velocity means and componentwise variances with a Gaussian posterior model. The same model evaluation supplies both a transport prediction and endpoint uncertainty, making posterior diagnostics available throughout generation. These learned moments support a mean-driven ordinary differential equation (ODE) and a posterior-driven stochastic differential equation (SDE), whose local noise scales adapt to the predicted uncertainty. Across image, point-cloud, molecular, and action generation, PFM improves generation quality and provides endpoint-posterior readouts throughout generation.

translated_abstract: 流匹配学习如何将噪声传输至数据，但其均值预测并不能直接报告中间状态下剩余的终点不确定性。本文提出了后验流匹配，这是一种通用的生成建模框架，通过高斯后验模型学习条件速度均值和各分量方差。同一次模型评估即可同时提供传输预测和终点不确定性，使得后验诊断在整个生成过程中随时可用。这些学习到的矩支持均值驱动的常微分方程（ODE）和后验驱动的随机微分方程（SDE），后者的局部噪声尺度会根据预测的不确定性进行自适应调整。在图像、点云、分子和动作生成等任务中，PFM 提升了生成质量，并在整个生成过程中提供终点后验读数。
tldr: 提出后验流匹配（PFM）框架，通过高斯后验模型在同一次模型评估中同时输出传输预测与终点不确定性，并支持均值驱动的ODE和后验驱动的SDE，在图像、点云、分子和动作生成任务中提升生成质量并实现全程后验诊断。
en_tdlr: Posterior Flow Matching (PFM) is a general generative framework that learns conditional velocity means and componentwise variances via a Gaussian posterior, supplying both transport predictions and endpoint uncertainty in a single model evaluation to improve generation quality and enable posterior diagnostics throughout generation across images, point clouds, molecules, and actions.
